title: gilia nudicaulis
intro: Gilia nudicaulis, commonly known as Yellow Toadshade, is a perennial plant species in the Phrymaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gilia nudicaulis are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system, exhibit antispasmodic effects, and act as a bronchodilator. The bioactive constituents of Gilia nudicaulis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
